name: The Divine
tagline: A heavenly agent sent to Earth on a mission. You hit hard, shrug off harm, and juggle orders from above with confusing mortal life.
luckSpecial: Each time you spend a Luck point, you receive word that your Mission needs something difficult done. By you. Urgently.

moves.intro: Beyond the basic moves you take three Divine moves, all chosen from the seven listed. None come for free.

choices.name: Boss from Beyond
choices.trig: At the beginning of each mystery
choices.full: Your Superiors give you a simple task. You may also put one investigate a mystery question to the Keeper straight away.
choices.part: Your Superiors give you a hard or tangled task. You may also put one investigate a mystery question to the Keeper straight away.
choices.miss: They order you to do something terrible. If you do not carry out what they ordered, you cannot use this move again until you have made up for it.
choices.note: On a 10+ or a 7-9 you can also ask one of the investigate a mystery questions at once. Whatever they asked for, if you do not carry it out you cannot use this move again until you have made up for it.

choices.name: Angel Wings
choices.trig: When you take one or two other people along on an Angel Wings jump
choices.full: You all arrive where you wanted to go.
choices.part: The jump goes slightly wrong: the group gets split up, or all of you land in the wrong spot.
choices.note: Travelling alone needs no roll: you instantly appear at any place you have been before, or beside someone you know well. You only roll when taking one or two passengers.

choices.name: What I Need, When I Need It
choices.summary: Any small item you own can be put away in a hidden magical pocket that no one else can reach. Take it out whenever you want and it lands in your hand.

choices.name: Smite
choices.summary: Against monsters, both your body and your divine weapon act as a weakness for them. Bare-handed, you hit for 2-harm intimate hand messy.

choices.name: Soothe
choices.summary: Murmur calmly to a person for a few seconds and their fear, anger or any other upset melts away. It still works if the cause of the upset is nearby, provided your voice can be heard.

choices.name: Lay On Hands
choices.trig: When you place your hands on a wounded or sick person to heal them
choices.full: Heal 2 harm or cure one illness, and the patient is stable.
choices.part: The healing works as on a 10+, but the harm or illness passes to you.
choices.miss: Your divine glow hurts them further.

choices.name: Cast Out Evil
choices.trig: When you try to banish an unnatural creature from your presence
choices.part: The banishing takes a little while: the creature has time to take one or two actions first.
choices.miss: Something holds the creature in place, which is bad news.
choices.note: The banished creature takes no damage and you cannot choose where it ends up. You may also use this on unnatural hunters such as the Monstrous.

gear.title: Divine armour
gear.intro: You also get divine armour. Give it a look that suits your divine origin.

extras.title: Mission
extras.intro: Your presence on Earth has a purpose. Choose one.

options.label: Fight an Adversary
options.detail: Your task is to thwart the plots of an Adversary.

options.label: Prevent the End of Days
options.detail: The world is near its End of Days. You steer these hunters so that it never happens.

options.label: Ensure the End of Days
options.detail: The world is near its End of Days. You steer these hunters so that it does happen.

options.label: Exiled
options.detail: You are an exile working for Good in secret, hiding from your kin, who are obliged to put you to death for what you did.

options.label: Prepare and protect another hunter
options.detail: Another hunter is meant to play a key part in what is coming. Train them for it and shield them whatever it takes.

history: If your mission is to protect another hunter, say to them: you have a key part to play in what comes, and you are here to lead and shield them.
They should not be mixed up in this, as no prophecy names them. That catches your notice, though you cannot tell why yet.
Deep down they are decent and just, and it is your job to keep them that way.
By rights they are a vile creature to be destroyed, yet you cannot do it. Figure out together what stops you.
Their prayer, whether casual or even unknowing, is what called you here.
You feel a strong physical pull towards them, and these human feelings confuse you.
They rescued you, and you recognise that you are in their debt.
They are your guide to everyday human life: food, sex, drugs, TV and the like.

improvements.text: Gain a lesser divine being as an ally, sent from above to help with your mission

advanced.text: Change this hunter to a new type
Create a second hunter to play as well as this one
Mark two of the basic moves as advanced
Mark another two of the basic moves as advanced
